title: bag.sync
description: The battle-usable bag subset, mirrored into the Minecraft inventory. MG6: also carries the save's money and the ledger stamp of the last projection (absent for a save never projected: the first adoption merges it into the ledger once).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.

stamp.description: MG6: the stamp bag.set wrote into the save's mod data; absent when the save was never projected.
